title: Machine Aided Estimation of Solar Cell Crack Caused Power Loss from Electroluminescence Images
mechanism: Cell power from inactive area plus histogram moments, with busbar count as a categorical predictor, using polynomial or custom non-linear regression.
adaptation: Simplest severity regressor for our cells (inactive fraction + busbar layout), if any paired cell I-V becomes available.
min_experiment: None until paired I-V data exists.
evidence: R: linear R2 0.85; improved to R2 0.869 with max error 0.17; 2 to 5 busbar mono cells.
